# Compact bounded YouTube bibliography pipeline

A ten-minute, phrase-only bibliography run with storyboard thumbnails and a timestamped continuation path.

## Compact bounded bibliography pipeline

Captions move through phrase curation, bounded verification, and portable export. A cap returns a continuation timestamp.

<!-- mermaid:id=bibliographer_flow -->
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  accTitle: Compact bounded bibliography pipeline
  accDescr: Start with a YouTube URL, retrieve captions, filter from the optional timestamp, extract meaningful multi-word phrases, globally deduplicate them, verify only the shortlist, then show results and a Markdown export. If the ten-minute or forty-hit limit is reached, save the cursor and offer a continuation URL.
  url["YouTube URL"]
  captions["Caption timeline"]
  cursor["Timestamp cursor"]
  phrases["Phrase-only extraction"]
  dedupe["Global dedupe"]
  verify["Bounded verification"]
  results["Results + thumbnails"]
  markdown["Markdown page"]
  cap["Cap&#58; time or 40 hits"]
  url --> captions
  captions --> cursor
  cursor --> phrases
  phrases --> dedupe
  dedupe --> verify
  verify --> results
  results --> markdown
  phrases -.->|limit| cap
  verify -.->|limit| cap
  cap -.->|continue at t=Ns| cursor
```
